title: SkillNEO: Non-Elitist Evolutionary Optimization of Agent Skills
abstract: arXiv:2610.20926v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent skills turn procedural knowledge into reusable artifacts, allowing LLM agents to accumulate and refine expertise through experience. Building on this, skill evolution iteratively improves skills using execution feedback. However, improvement may require several interdependent edits, so low-reward versions can still be worth developing. Requiring immediate reward gains can discard useful partial repairs before their benefits emerge. Non-elitist evolution allows new versions to receive further edits despite scoring below earlier ones. For agent skills, this calls for evidence of what to preserve and repair next. We introduce SkillNEO (Non-Elitist Evolutionary Optimization for Agent Skills), which separately selects a version to use and versions to keep improving. translated_title: SkillNEO：智能体技能的非精英主义进化优化
translated_abstract: 智能体技能将程序性知识转化为可复用的产物，使LLM智能体能够通过经验积累和完善专业知识。在此基础上，技能进化利用执行反馈迭代改进技能。然而，改进可能需要多次相互依赖的编辑，因此低奖励版本仍然值得继续开发。若要求立即获得奖励提升，可能会在部分修复的效果显现之前就丢弃这些有价值的修改。非精英主义进化允许新版本即使得分低于早期版本，也能继续接受编辑。对于智能体技能而言，这需要证据来指明应保留什么以及下一步修复什么。我们提出了SkillNEO（智能体技能的非精英主义进化优化），它将“选择使用的版本”与“选择继续改进的版本”分离开来。通过比较相关版本执行同一任务的表现，可以识别出应保留的有效步骤以及尚待修复的失败之处。它还可以利用后续版本的经验重新审视和修改早期版本。
tldr: SkillNEO提出了一种非精英主义的智能体技能进化优化方法，通过分离“使用的版本”与“持续改进的版本”的选择，允许得分较低的版本继续接受编辑完善，从而避免因要求立即获得奖励提升而丢弃有价值的多步部分修复。
en_tdlr: SkillNEO introduces a non-elitist evolutionary optimization framework for agent skills that separately selects versions to use and versions to keep improving, enabling low-reward versions with useful partial repairs to receive further edits instead of being prematurely discarded.
